name: @w6w-apps/capsulecrm
description: Manage Capsule CRM parties, opportunities, tasks and account metadata via the Capsule API v2. Triggers: new/updated parties and opportunities, new pipelines, milestones and users.

w6w.longDescription:
Capsule is a simple, straightforward CRM built around a single core idea: a Party (a person or organisation) with everything else — opportunities, tasks, cases — hung off it. This app covers that model over the Capsule API v2: creating, finding, updating and deleting parties; running opportunities through a sales pipeline (which requires resolving a pipeline's milestone ids first); and creating and updating tasks linked to a party or opportunity.

Good for syncing contacts and companies from a signup or lead-capture form, keeping a deal's pipeline stage and value current from an external system, creating follow-up tasks from another tool's events, or looking up a party by a free-text search before deciding whether to create a duplicate.

Poll triggers start a workflow when a new record appears or an existing one is edited, using the same list call as the matching action.
